name: Guinea-Bissau

elections.note: 102-seat National People's Assembly. Set by junta decree.

leaders: Transitional President Gen. Horta Inta-A Na Man (military)
summary: The November 2025 elections were annulled after a military coup ousted President Umaro Sissoco Embaló. The junta set a one-year transition ending in these polls. Publishing opinion polls is banned.

policies: Demands a swift return to constitutional order
